nature Electrical
  potential Voltage v "V" abstol 1e-6
  flow Current i "A" abstol 1e-12
body A2D
  param vth: f64 = 0.6
  param hyst: f64 = 0.05
  node a: Electrical port
  carrier d: bool out init false
  carrier above$0.init$0.up: bool signal init true
  carrier above$1.init$0.up: bool signal init true
  event E0 cross ((probe(a, gnd) - vth) - (hyst / 2.0))
  event E1 changed above$0.init$0.up
  event E2 cross ((vth - (hyst / 2.0)) - probe(a, gnd))
  event E3 changed above$1.init$0.up
  reaction R0 on (E0, E1)
    if (fired(E0) || (fired(E1) && (((probe(a, gnd) - vth) - (hyst / 2.0)) > 0.0))) { d <- true } else { () }
  reaction R1 on (E2, E3)
    if (fired(E2) || (fired(E3) && (((vth - (hyst / 2.0)) - probe(a, gnd)) > 0.0))) { d <- false } else { () }
body Adc
  param vref: f64 = 1.6 where (vref > 0.0)
  param tconv: f64 = 5e-7 where (tconv > 0.0)
  param tstrobe: f64 = 5e-9 where (tstrobe > 0.0)
  node ain: Electrical port
  carrier sample: bool in
  carrier code: u10 out init 0
  carrier done: bool out init false
  event E0 changed sample guard ((!sample.prev().high()) & ((!sample.is_known()) | sample.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    local q: u10
    let q = ((((probe(ain, gnd) / vref) * 1024.0) + 0.5).floor().clamp(0.0, 1023.0) as u10)
    code <- q after tconv
    done <- true after tconv
    done <- false after (tconv + tstrobe)
body Buck
  param vin_nom: f64 = 12.0 where (vin_nom >= 0.0)
  param rs_in: f64 = 0.02 where (rs_in > 0.0)
  param l: f64 = 4.7e-6 where (l > 0.0)
  param dcr: f64 = 0.015 where (dcr >= 0.0)
  param cout: f64 = 0.00022 where (cout > 0.0)
  param esr: f64 = 0.003 where (esr > 0.0)
  param cin: f64 = 2.2e-5 where (cin > 0.0)
  param ron: f64 = 0.02 where (ron > 0.0)
  param t_driver: f64 = 1e-8 where (t_driver > 0.0)
  param r_load: f64 = 6.6 where (r_load > 0.0)
  param r_step: f64 = 0.825 where (r_step > 0.0)
  param t_step: f64 = 4e-6 where (t_step > 0.0)
  param i_inject: f64 = 5.0
  param f_clk: f64 = 200000000.0 where (f_clk > 0.0)
  node vin: Electrical signal
  node vout: Electrical signal
  node isense: Electrical signal
  node isense_n: Electrical signal
  carrier en: bool in
  carrier sp_wr: bool in
  carrier sp_data: u8 in
  carrier load_step: bool in
  carrier inject: bool in
  carrier pgood: bool out
  carrier fault: u2 out
  carrier mode: u2 out
  carrier clk: bool signal
  carrier hs_cmd: bool signal
  carrier ls_cmd: bool signal
  carrier sample: bool signal
  carrier code: u10 signal
  carrier done: bool signal
  carrier vin_ok: bool signal
  carrier oc: bool signal
  carrier sink_oc: bool signal
  child osc: Osc  nodes ()  params (f = f_clk)  carriers (clk)
  child supply: Supply  nodes (vin, gnd)  params (vin = vin_nom, rs = rs_in)
  child power: PowerStage  nodes (vin, vout, isense, isense_n, gnd, gnd)  params (l = l, dcr = dcr, cout = cout, esr = esr, cin = cin, ron = ron, tpd = t_driver)  carriers (hs_cmd, ls_cmd)
  child load: Load  nodes (vout)  params (r_base = r_load, r_step = r_step, tr = t_step, i_inject = i_inject)  carriers (load_step, inject)
  child meas: Sensing  nodes (vin, vout, isense, isense_n, gnd, gnd)  params ()  carriers (sample, code, done, vin_ok, oc, sink_oc)
  child ctl: Controller  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (clk, en, sp_wr, sp_data, code, done, vin_ok, oc, sink_oc, hs_cmd, ls_cmd, sample, pgood, fault, mode)
body Capacitor
  param c: f64 where (c > 0.0)
  param esr: f64 = 0.001 where (esr > 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  node mid: Electrical signal
  branch b0 (p, mid) flow
  branch b1 (mid, n) flow
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct (probe(p, mid) / esr)
    b1.flow +> ddt (c * probe(mid, n))
body Controller
  carrier clk: bool in
  carrier en: bool in
  carrier sp_wr: bool in
  carrier sp_data: u8 in
  carrier code: u10 in
  carrier done: bool in
  carrier vin_ok: bool in
  carrier oc: bool in
  carrier sink_oc: bool in
  carrier hs_cmd: bool out
  carrier ls_cmd: bool out
  carrier sample: bool out
  carrier pgood: bool out
  carrier fault: u2 out
  carrier mode: u2 out
  carrier setpoint: u8 signal
  carrier reference: u10 signal
  carrier duty: u12 signal
  carrier at_target: bool signal
  carrier run: bool signal
  carrier cut: bool signal
  carrier ramp.target: u10 signal
  child reg: SetpointReg  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (sp_wr, sp_data, setpoint)
  child ramp: RefRamp  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (done, run, ramp.target, reference, at_target)
  child pid: Pid  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (done, run, reference, code, duty)
  child sup: Supervisor  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (done, en, vin_ok, cut, code, reference, at_target, run, pgood, mode, fault)
  child pwm: Dpwm  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (clk, run, duty, oc, sink_oc, hs_cmd, ls_cmd, sample, cut)
  drive ramp.target = target_codes(setpoint.known_or(0u8))
body CurrentSense
  param rshunt: f64 = 0.005 where (rshunt > 0.0)
  param gain: f64 = 20.0
  node a: Electrical port
  node b: Electrical port
  node pos: Electrical port
  node neg: Electrical port
  branch b0 (a, b) flow
  branch b1 (pos, gnd) potential
  branch b2 (neg, gnd) potential
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct (probe(a, b) / rshunt)
    b1.potential +> direct (gain * probe(a, b))
    b2.potential +> direct ((-gain) * probe(a, b))
body Divider
  param r_top: f64 where (r_top > 0.0)
  param r_bot: f64 where (r_bot > 0.0)
  node top: Electrical port
  node mid: Electrical port
  child upper: Resistor  nodes (top, mid)  params (r = r_top)
  child lower: Resistor  nodes (mid, gnd)  params (r = r_bot)
body Dpwm
  carrier clk: bool in
  carrier run: bool in
  carrier duty: u12 in
  carrier oc: bool in
  carrier sink_oc: bool in
  carrier hs: bool out init false
  carrier ls: bool out init false
  carrier sample: bool out
  carrier cut: bool out init false
  carrier count: u9 signal init 0
  carrier width: u9 signal init 0
  carrier frame: u3 signal init 0
  carrier hs_off: u9 signal init 0
  carrier hs_cut: bool signal init false
  carrier ls_cut: bool signal init false
  carrier no_shoot_through.bad: bool signal
  child no_shoot_through: Never  nodes ()  params ()  carriers (clk, no_shoot_through.bad)
  drive sample = (count == 0u9)
  drive no_shoot_through.bad = (hs & ls)
  event E0 changed clk guard ((!clk.prev().high()) & ((!clk.is_known()) | clk.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    local enabled: bool
    local hs_next: flagged<bool>
    local hs_trip: flagged<bool>
    local ls_next: flagged<bool>
    local ls_trip: flagged<bool>
    local next: flagged<u9>
    local off_at: flagged<u9>
    local w: flagged<u9>
    local wrap: flagged<bool>
    let wrap = (count == 399u9)
    let next = if wrap { 0u9 } else { (count + 1u9) }
    let enabled = run.known_or(false)
    let w = if wrap { "dithered_width~01"(duty.known_or(0u12), (frame + 1u3)) } else { width }
    let hs_trip = ((!wrap) & (hs_cut | (hs & oc.known_or(true))))
    let ls_trip = ((!wrap) & (ls_cut | (ls & sink_oc.known_or(true))))
    let hs_next = ((enabled & (!hs_trip)) & (next < w))
    let off_at = if wrap { w } else { if (hs & (!hs_next)) { next } else { hs_off } }
    let ls_next = ((((enabled & (!hs_next)) & (!ls_trip)) & (next >= (off_at + 4u9))) & (next < 396u9))
    count <- next
    width <- w
    hs_off <- off_at
    hs_cut <- hs_trip
    ls_cut <- ls_trip
    hs <- hs_next
    ls <- ls_next
    if wrap { frame <- (frame + 1u3); cut <- hs_cut } else { () }
body GateDriver
  param tpd: f64 = 1e-8 where (tpd > 0.0)
  carrier hs_cmd: bool in
  carrier ls_cmd: bool in
  carrier hs_gate: bool out
  carrier ls_gate: bool out
  drive hs_gate = (hs_cmd & (!ls_cmd)) after tpd
  drive ls_gate = (ls_cmd & (!hs_cmd)) after tpd
body Inductor
  param l: f64 where (l > 0.0)
  param dcr: f64 = 0.0 where (dcr >= 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) potential
  analog
    b0.potential +> ddt (l * flow(b0)), direct (dcr * flow(b0))
body Load
  param r_base: f64 = 6.6 where (r_base > 0.0)
  param r_step: f64 = 0.825 where (r_step > 0.0)
  param tr: f64 = 4e-6 where (tr > 0.0)
  param i_inject: f64 = 5.0
  node p: Electrical port
  carrier step: bool in
  carrier inject: bool in
  carrier k_step.x: f64 signal
  carrier k_step.xd: f64 signal
  carrier k_step.y0: f64 signal
  carrier k_step.y1: f64 signal
  carrier k_step.t0: f64 signal init 0.0
  carrier k_step.dt: f64 signal init 0.0
  carrier k_inject.x: f64 signal
  carrier k_inject.xd: f64 signal
  carrier k_inject.y0: f64 signal
  carrier k_inject.y1: f64 signal
  carrier k_inject.t0: f64 signal init 0.0
  carrier k_inject.dt: f64 signal init 0.0
  branch b0 (p, gnd) flow
  drive k_step.x = if step.high() { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
  drive k_step.xd = k_step.x after 0.0
  drive k_inject.x = if inject.high() { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
  drive k_inject.xd = k_inject.x after 0.0
  event E0 at (k_step.t0 + k_step.dt) guard (k_step.dt > 0.0)
  event E1 changed k_step.x
  event E2 changed k_step.xd
  event E3 at (k_inject.t0 + k_inject.dt) guard (k_inject.dt > 0.0)
  event E4 changed k_inject.x
  event E5 changed k_inject.xd
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct ((probe(p, gnd) * ((1.0 / r_base) + (if static() { k_step.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_step.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_step.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_step.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_step.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_step.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) } } / r_step))) - (if static() { k_inject.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_inject.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) } } * i_inject))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    k_step.dt <- 0.0
  reaction R1 on (E1)
    if static() { k_step.y0 <- k_step.x; k_step.y1 <- k_step.x } else { () }
  reaction R2 on (E2)
    local to: f64
    if (!static()) { if k_step.xd.is_known() { let to = k_step.xd.known_or(0.0); k_step.y0 <- if static() { k_step.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_step.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_step.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_step.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_step.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_step.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) } }; k_step.y1 <- to; k_step.t0 <- time(); k_step.dt <- if (to > if static() { k_step.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_step.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_step.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_step.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_step.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_step.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) { tr } else { if (to < if static() { k_step.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_step.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_step.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_step.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_step.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_step.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_step.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) { tr } else { 0.0 } } } else { () } } else { () }
  reaction R3 on (E3)
    k_inject.dt <- 0.0
  reaction R4 on (E4)
    if static() { k_inject.y0 <- k_inject.x; k_inject.y1 <- k_inject.x } else { () }
  reaction R5 on (E5)
    local to: f64
    if (!static()) { if k_inject.xd.is_known() { let to = k_inject.xd.known_or(0.0); k_inject.y0 <- if static() { k_inject.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_inject.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) } }; k_inject.y1 <- to; k_inject.t0 <- time(); k_inject.dt <- if (to > if static() { k_inject.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_inject.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) { tr } else { if (to < if static() { k_inject.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) - k_inject.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - k_inject.t0.known_or(0.0)) / k_inject.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { k_inject.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) { tr } else { 0.0 } } } else { () } } else { () }
body Never
  carrier clk: bool in
  carrier bad: bool in
  stream checks (pass: bool)
  event E0 changed clk guard ((!clk.prev().high()) & ((!clk.is_known()) | clk.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    local require.pass: flagged<bool>
    let require.pass = (!bad)
    emit checks(kind = "require", name = "never", pass = require.pass)
body Osc
  param f: f64 = 200000000.0 where (f > 0.0)
  carrier clk: bool out init false
  event E0 changed clk
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    clk <- (!clk) after (0.5 / f)
body Pid
  carrier tick: bool in
  carrier run: bool in
  carrier reference: u10 in
  carrier meas: u10 in
  carrier duty: u12 out init 0
  carrier integ: i32 signal init 0
  carrier deriv: i32 signal init 0
  carrier e_prev: i16 signal init 0
  event E0 changed tick guard ((!tick.prev().high()) & ((!tick.is_known()) | tick.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    local d: flagged<i32>
    local e: i16
    local p: i32
    local u: flagged<i32>
    local u_max: i32
    local windup: flagged<bool>
    if (!run.known_or(false)) { integ <- 0i32; deriv <- 0i32; e_prev <- 0i16; duty <- 0u12 } else { let e = ((reference.known_or(0u10) as i16) - (meas.known_or(1023u10) as i16)).clamp(-256i16, 255i16); let p = (64i32 * (e as i32)); let d = ((deriv >> 2i32) + (1024i32 * ((e - e_prev) as i32))); let u = (((p + integ) + d) >> 4i32); let u_max = 2880i32; let windup = (((u > u_max) & (e > 0i16)) | ((u < 0i32) & (e < 0i16))); if (!windup) { integ <- (integ + (8i32 * (e as i32))).clamp(0i32, (u_max << 4i32)) } else { () }; deriv <- d; e_prev <- e; duty <- (u.clamp(0i32, u_max) as u12) }
body PowerStage
  param l: f64 = 4.7e-6
  param dcr: f64 = 0.015
  param cout: f64 = 0.00022
  param esr: f64 = 0.003
  param cin: f64 = 2.2e-5
  param esr_in: f64 = 0.005
  param ron: f64 = 0.02
  param tpd: f64 = 1e-8
  node vin: Electrical port
  node vout: Electrical port
  node isense: Electrical port
  node isense_n: Electrical port
  node sw: Electrical signal
  node lx: Electrical signal
  carrier hs_cmd: bool in
  carrier ls_cmd: bool in
  carrier hs_gate: bool signal
  carrier ls_gate: bool signal
  child drv: GateDriver  nodes ()  params (tpd = tpd)  carriers (hs_cmd, ls_cmd, hs_gate, ls_gate)
  child hs: PowerSwitch  nodes (vin, sw)  params (ron = ron)  carriers (hs_gate)
  child ls: PowerSwitch  nodes (sw, gnd)  params (ron = ron)  carriers (ls_gate)
  child ind: Inductor  nodes (sw, lx)  params (l = l, dcr = dcr)
  child shunt: CurrentSense  nodes (lx, vout, isense, isense_n)  params ()
  child c_out: Capacitor  nodes (vout, gnd, gnd)  params (c = cout, esr = esr)
  child c_in: Capacitor  nodes (vin, gnd, gnd)  params (c = cin, esr = esr_in)
body PowerSwitch
  param ron: f64 = 0.02 where (ron > 0.0)
  param roff: f64 = 1000000.0 where (roff > ron)
  param tsw: f64 = 5e-9 where (tsw > 0.0)
  param coss: f64 = 2e-10 where (coss >= 0.0)
  param vf: f64 = 0.7
  param rd: f64 = 0.02 where (rd > 0.0)
  node d: Electrical port
  node s: Electrical port
  carrier g: bool in
  carrier gate.x: f64 signal
  carrier gate.xd: f64 signal
  carrier gate.y0: f64 signal
  carrier gate.y1: f64 signal
  carrier gate.t0: f64 signal init 0.0
  carrier gate.dt: f64 signal init 0.0
  branch b0 (d, s) flow
  local gch: f64
  drive gate.x = if g.high() { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
  drive gate.xd = gate.x after 0.0
  event E0 at (gate.t0 + gate.dt) guard (gate.dt > 0.0)
  event E1 changed gate.x
  event E2 changed gate.xd
  analog
    let gch = ((if static() { gate.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (gate.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (gate.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((gate.y1.known_or(0.0) - gate.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - gate.t0.known_or(0.0)) / gate.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { gate.y1.known_or(0.0) } } / ron) + ((1.0 - if static() { gate.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (gate.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (gate.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((gate.y1.known_or(0.0) - gate.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - gate.t0.known_or(0.0)) / gate.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { gate.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) / roff))
    b0.flow +> direct ((gch * probe(d, s)) - body_diode(probe(s, d), vf, rd)), ddt (coss * probe(d, s))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    gate.dt <- 0.0
  reaction R1 on (E1)
    if static() { gate.y0 <- gate.x; gate.y1 <- gate.x } else { () }
  reaction R2 on (E2)
    local to: f64
    if (!static()) { if gate.xd.is_known() { let to = gate.xd.known_or(0.0); gate.y0 <- if static() { gate.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (gate.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (gate.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((gate.y1.known_or(0.0) - gate.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - gate.t0.known_or(0.0)) / gate.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { gate.y1.known_or(0.0) } }; gate.y1 <- to; gate.t0 <- time(); gate.dt <- if (to > if static() { gate.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (gate.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (gate.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((gate.y1.known_or(0.0) - gate.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - gate.t0.known_or(0.0)) / gate.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { gate.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) { tsw } else { if (to < if static() { gate.x.known_or(0.0) } else { if (gate.dt.known_or(0.0) > 0.0) { (gate.y0.known_or(0.0) + ((gate.y1.known_or(0.0) - gate.y0.known_or(0.0)) * ((time() - gate.t0.known_or(0.0)) / gate.dt.known_or(0.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0))) } else { gate.y1.known_or(0.0) } }) { tsw } else { 0.0 } } } else { () } } else { () }
body RefRamp
  carrier tick: bool in
  carrier run: bool in
  carrier target: u10 in
  carrier reference: u10 out init 0
  carrier at_target: bool out
  drive at_target = (reference == target)
  event E0 changed tick guard ((!tick.prev().high()) & ((!tick.is_known()) | tick.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    if (!run.known_or(false)) { reference <- 0u10 } else { if (reference < target) { reference <- (reference + 1u10) } else { if (reference > target) { reference <- (reference - 1u10) } else { () } } }
body Resistor
  param r: f64 where (r > 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) flow
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct (probe(p, n) / r)
body Sensing
  node vin: Electrical port
  node vout: Electrical port
  node isense: Electrical port
  node isense_n: Electrical port
  node fb: Electrical signal
  node vin_div: Electrical signal
  carrier sample: bool in
  carrier code: u10 out
  carrier done: bool out
  carrier vin_ok: bool out
  carrier oc: bool out
  carrier sink_oc: bool out
  child fb_div: Divider  nodes (vout, fb)  params (r_top = 30000.0, r_bot = 10000.0)
  child adc: Adc  nodes (fb)  params ()  carriers (sample, code, done)
  child uv_div: Divider  nodes (vin, vin_div)  params (r_top = 90000.0, r_bot = 10000.0)
  child uvlo: A2D  nodes (vin_div)  params (vth = 0.825, hyst = 0.05)  carriers (vin_ok)
  child ocp: A2D  nodes (isense)  params (vth = 0.74, hyst = 0.02)  carriers (oc)
  child scp: A2D  nodes (isense_n)  params (vth = 0.29, hyst = 0.02)  carriers (sink_oc)
body SetpointReg
  carrier wr: bool in
  carrier data: u8 in
  carrier code: u8 out init 100
  event E0 changed wr guard ((!wr.prev().high()) & ((!wr.is_known()) | wr.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    local d: u8
    if data.is_known() { let d = data.known_or(0u8); code <- d.min(168u8) } else { () }
body Supervisor
  carrier tick: bool in
  carrier en: bool in
  carrier vin_ok: bool in
  carrier cut: bool in
  carrier meas: u10 in
  carrier reference: u10 in
  carrier at_target: bool in
  carrier run: bool out
  carrier pgood: bool out init false
  carrier mode: u2 out init 0
  carrier fault: u2 out init 0
  carrier oc_count: u4 signal init 0
  carrier ov_count: u2 signal init 0
  carrier retry: u11 signal init 0
  carrier pg_in: u7 signal init 0
  carrier pg_out: u3 signal init 0
  stream log (severity: u2)
  drive run = ((mode == 1u2) | (mode == 2u2))
  event E0 changed tick guard ((!tick.prev().high()) & ((!tick.is_known()) | tick.known_or(false)))
  reaction R0 on (E0)
    local enabled: bool
    local f: flagged<u2>
    local fault_now.is: flagged<bool>
    local fault_now.val: flagged<u2>
    local in_n: flagged<u7>
    local inside: bool
    local log.severity: u2
    local m: u10
    local match$0: u2
    local oc_n: flagged<u4>
    local out_n: flagged<u3>
    local ov_n: flagged<u2>
    local r: u10
    local regulating: flagged<bool>
    let enabled = (en.known_or(false) && vin_ok.known_or(false))
    let m = meas.known_or(1023u10)
    let r = reference.known_or(0u10)
    let oc_n = if (!cut.known_or(true)) { 0u4 } else { if (oc_count < 8u4) { (oc_count + 1u4) } else { 8u4 } }
    let ov_n = if (m <= ovp_threshold(r)) { 0u2 } else { if (ov_count < 2u2) { (ov_count + 1u2) } else { 2u2 } }
    let fault_now.is = if (oc_n >= 8u4) { true } else { if (ov_n >= 2u2) { true } else { false } }
    let fault_now.val = if (oc_n >= 8u4) { 1u2 } else { if (ov_n >= 2u2) { 2u2 } else { 0u2 } }
    oc_count <- oc_n
    ov_count <- ov_n
    if (!enabled) { mode <- 0u2 } else { let match$0 = mode.known_or(0u2); if (match$0 == 0u2) { mode <- 1u2 } else { if (match$0 == 3u2) { if (retry == 0u11) { mode <- 1u2 } else { retry <- (retry - 1u11) } } else { if fault_now.is { let f = fault_now.val; mode <- 3u2; fault <- f; retry <- 1000u11; let log.severity = 1u2; emit log(severity = log.severity, msg = "buck: fault, entering hiccup") } else { if ((mode == 1u2) & at_target.known_or(false)) { mode <- 2u2; fault <- 0u2 } else { () } } } } }
    let regulating = (((mode == 2u2) & enabled) & (!fault_now.is))
    let inside = in_window(m, r)
    let in_n = if (!(regulating & inside)) { 0u7 } else { if (pg_in < 64u7) { (pg_in + 1u7) } else { 64u7 } }
    let out_n = if (!(regulating & (!inside))) { 0u3 } else { if (pg_out < 4u3) { (pg_out + 1u3) } else { 4u3 } }
    pg_in <- in_n
    pg_out <- out_n
    if (!regulating) { pgood <- false } else { if (in_n >= 64u7) { pgood <- true } else { if (out_n >= 4u3) { pgood <- false } else { () } } }
body Supply
  param vin: f64 = 12.0 where (vin >= 0.0)
  param rs: f64 = 0.02 where (rs > 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node src: Electrical signal
  branch b0 (src, gnd) potential
  branch b1 (src, p) flow
  analog
    b0.potential +> direct vin
    b1.flow +> direct (probe(src, p) / rs)
fn "dithered_width~01"(duty: u12, frame: flagged<u3>) -> flagged<u9>
  local coarse: u9
  local duty: u12
  local fine: u3
  local frame: flagged<u3>
  let coarse = ((duty >> 3i32) as u9)
  let fine = ((duty & 7u12) as u3)
  if ("rev3~1"(frame) < fine) { (coarse + 1u9) } else { coarse }
fn "rev3~1"(k: flagged<u3>) -> flagged<u3>
  local k: flagged<u3>
  ((((k & 1u3) << 2i32) | (k & 2u3)) | ((k >> 2i32) & 1u3))
fn body_diode(vsd: f64, vf: f64, rd: f64) -> f64
  local rd: f64
  local vf: f64
  local vs: f64
  local vsd: f64
  local x: f64
  let vs = 0.025
  let x = ((vsd - vf) / vs)
  ((vs / rd) * if (x > 40.0) { x } else { ln((1.0 + exp(x))) })
fn in_window(meas: u10, reference: u10) -> bool
  local half: u11
  local m: u11
  local meas: u10
  local r: u11
  local reference: u10
  let m = (meas as u11)
  let r = (reference as u11)
  let half = (r >> 4i32)
  (((m + half) >= r) && (m <= (r + half)))
fn ovp_threshold(reference: u10) -> u10
  local reference: u10
  ((reference + (reference >> 3i32)) + 16u10)
fn target_codes(setpoint: u8) -> u10
  local setpoint: u8
  (128u10 + ((setpoint as u10) << 2i32))
